```text
Local Nix substituter proxy: one localhost endpoint, the best reachable upstream behind it

Usage: sito [OPTIONS] --config <CONFIG>

Options:
      --config <CONFIG>  Path to the TOML config file [env: SITO_CONFIG=]
      --listen <LISTEN>  Override the listen address from the config file [env: SITO_LISTEN=]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
```
